prompt: How many 20th-century paintings have been sold for at least $100 million (in nominal sale price) at Christie’s New York since 2020?
answer:
**Five** 20th-century paintings have sold for at least **$100 million nominally** at Christie’s New York since 2020:

| Year | Painting | Artist | Sale price |
|---|---|---|---:|
| 2021 | *Femme assise près d’une fenêtre (Marie-Thérèse)* | Pablo Picasso | $103.4 million |
| 2022 | *Shot Sage Blue Marilyn* | Andy Warhol | $195 million |
| 2022 | *Birch Forest* | Gustav Klimt | $104.6 million |
| 2024 | *L’Empire des lumières* | René Magritte | $121 million |
| 2026 | *Number 7A, 1948* | Jackson Pollock | $181.2 million |

The higher-priced 2022 Paul Allen-sale works by Van Gogh, Cézanne, Gauguin, and Seurat are excluded because they were painted in the **19th century**.
